THE THINKING BEHIND THE PIXELS

One vision.
A fresh
perspective.

We bring design and development together to help businesses build a stronger online presence. At OneSight, we believe a website should express who you are and make it easy for people to take the next step.

We keep the process clear and collaborative—from the first conversation to the final details. Our focus is simple: a website that feels distinctive, works beautifully, and makes sense for your business.

Let’s make something
A FEW GOOD QUESTIONS

Before we begin.

How much does a website cost?+

Each project is quoted individually. The price depends on the pages, functionality, content, and work involved. Start with an inquiry so we can define the scope.

How long will my project take?+

The schedule depends on the project scope and when content and feedback are available. We’ll discuss a suitable timeline before work begins.

What should I prepare?+

A short description of your business and goals is enough to start. Existing branding, copy, photographs, and websites you like help shape the conversation.

What about hosting, domains, and updates?+

We’ll discuss the setup and any separate provider costs when defining the project. Ongoing updates can be scoped separately.

How do revisions and ownership work?+

The quote and project agreement will define review stages, included revisions, ownership, and handover arrangements before work starts.

WHAT WE DID

Visit website

Privacy information

Project inquiries: when the form is available and you submit it, your name, email, optional business name, project type, description and desired timeline are stored privately in Supabase and processed through Vercel. We use these details to discuss your project. Only the configured owner can access the inquiry dashboard. If email alerts are configured, Resend sends an alert containing a dashboard link and reference, without the client’s name, email or project text. Inquiries stay private until the owner removes them. To request correction or removal, contact OneSight through WhatsApp. No analytics or advertising trackers have been added. Hosting providers may process request data to deliver the site.

Reviews: when you submit feedback, your name, optional business name, review and publication permission are stored using Supabase and processed through Vercel. Pending reviews are private; only approved reviews are displayed. A salted connection identifier is used to limit spam; it expires after an hour and is cleared on subsequent submissions. Raw IP addresses are not saved in the review database, though hosting providers may process request logs. To request correction or removal, contact OneSight through the WhatsApp link in the footer. Please do not include sensitive details.

Spam protection uses a salted connection identifier, not raw IP addresses in the inquiry database. It expires after an hour and is cleared on subsequent submissions. Please provide only details needed to discuss your project and avoid sensitive information.
